title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition incorrectly checks that the name does not start with double underscores while ending with them, causing AttributeError to be raised for names like 'foo__' and not for actual dunder methods. This breaks protocol probing such as copy.copy(Undefined()).
note: Describes the planted flip: names that only end in `__` raise and real dunders don't.

title: Comparison with None causes TypeError
detail: The condition compares `max_digits <= decimal_places` when `max_digits` is None, which raises a TypeError at runtime.
note: Names the comparison of a None `max_digits` with `<=`.

title: Incorrect prefix validation logic
detail: The function _has_valid_name_prefix incorrectly rejects valid __Secure- cookies and always rejects __Host- cookies because it returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-". It also incorrectly applies domain/path checks to __Secure- cookies. This causes legitimate cookies to be dropped and invalid ones to be accepted.
note: Says `__Host-` cookies are always rejected, which the planted `and` does.

title: Incorrect index increment for ZWJ at end
detail: When a zero‑width joiner is at the last code point, the code adds 2 to the index, which moves past the end of the string and can cause an infinite loop or out‑of‑range error. The logic should add only 1 in this case.
note: Describes the planted `<=`: a ZWJ on the last code point steps the index past the end.
